beacon_get_node.description: Get one node by its Beacon node UUID, including optional MeshMapper repeater metadata (site, scopes, default scope, and admins) when the server has imported a matching MeshMapper entry.
beacon_get_node.name: beacon_get_node

beacon_get_observer_activity.description: Get heard-activity history for one observer. The points array is sparse: intervals with no recorded observations may be omitted rather than returned as zero. When interval is 5m or 15m, including when interval is omitted, range must be 48h or less.

range.description: Positive whole minutes or hours, at most 720h (43200m); combined values such as 1h30m are not supported

until.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with a valid calendar date, for example 2026-10-04T15:30:00Z

beacon_get_observer_activity.name: beacon_get_observer_activity

lastCompleteHour.description: Upstream field name is misleading: this value is the observation count for the latest complete hour, not an hour number or timestamp

beacon_get_server_info.description: Get the connected Beacon server version and minimum supported BEACON Mobile and Beacon Web versions. minAppVersion and minWebVersion are null when the server sets no respective minimum requirement.
beacon_get_server_info.name: beacon_get_server_info

beacon_list_iatas.description: List Beacon geographic areas identified by IATA-style codes. This is a bounded enumeration with no server-side pagination; if the list exceeds the limit, the response reports truncation. Codes represent network partitions and do not necessarily refer to the corresponding airport.
beacon_list_iatas.name: beacon_list_iatas

items.description: Beacon geographic area identified by an IATA-style code; it is a network partition and not necessarily an airport

beacon_list_scopes.description: List public MeshCore transport scopes. region and regionId are mutually exclusive.

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

region.description: Exact case-sensitive region slug as returned by beacon_list_regions.slug; the display name (e.g. Sverige) will not match

beacon_list_scopes.name: beacon_list_scopes

nextCursor.description: Continuation page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is

beacon_search_nodes.description: Search known MeshCore nodes. Sort by lastSeen (newest first by default), name, type or neighbors; order defaults to asc except lastSeen (desc). For continuation pass both pageCursor and cursor when returned, so older servers can use the numeric fallback. A numeric cursor only works with default newest-first ordering. region and regionId are mutually exclusive, as are type and typeName.

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

neighbors.description: Include neighborIds in each node summary; can increase response size

pageCursor.description: Opaque nextPageCursor returned as pagination.nextCursor.pageCursor; pass unchanged with the same filters and sort

pubkey.description: Exact 32-byte MeshCore public key as 64 hexadecimal characters

pubkeyPrefix.description: Hexadecimal prefix of a MeshCore public key

region.description: Exact case-sensitive region slug as returned by beacon_list_regions.slug; the display name (e.g. Sverige) will not match

scope.description: Transport scope name such as "#se13"; matching is case-sensitive, so the exact casing used by the network matters, unlike IATA inputs which are normalized to uppercase

beacon_search_nodes.name: beacon_search_nodes

anyOf.description: Continuation page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is
Pass pageCursor and, when present, cursor unchanged with the same filters and sort; older servers ignore pageCursor

beacon_search_observers.description: Search Beacon observers/gateways. For continuation pass both pageCursor and cursor when returned: the opaque token preserves millisecond ties, the numeric cursor supports older servers. region and regionId are mutually exclusive.

items.description: Three-character IATA identifier; normalized to uppercase

pageCursor.description: Opaque nextPageCursor returned as pagination.nextCursor.pageCursor; pass unchanged with the same filters and sort

region.description: Exact case-sensitive region slug as returned by beacon_list_regions.slug; the display name (e.g. Sverige) will not match

scope.description: Transport scope name such as "#se13"; matching is case-sensitive, so the exact casing used by the network matters, unlike IATA inputs which are normalized to uppercase

beacon_search_observers.name: beacon_search_observers

anyOf.description: Continuation page cursor; pass the value to the next call as-is
Pass pageCursor and, when present, cursor unchanged with the same filters and sort; older servers ignore pageCursor
